title: Snow Water Supply Forecasting Reauthorization Act of 2025
official_title: To amend the Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program Authorization Act.
likelihoodReason: Introduced by Rep. Hurd (R-CO) with Rep. Neguse (D-CO) and 2 cosponsors; passed the House and was ordered reported favorably by the Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee. A bipartisan reauthorization of an existing water-data program tends to clear the Senate when floor time allows.
summary: Renews and updates the federal Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program through 2031, shifting its focus toward advanced snowpack measurement and modeling technologies.
brief: Reauthorizes the Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program for fiscal years 2027-2031 and refocuses it on integrated snowpack measurement and modeling.

sections.label: Section 2 — Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program

items.main: Reauthorizes and updates the Snow Water Supply Forecasting Program (43 U.S.C. 1477) through fiscal year 2031.
items.detail: Reauthorizes appropriations of $3 million for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031, replacing the prior aggregate authorization for fiscal years 2022 through 2026. Refocuses the program on deploying technologies that provide complete integration of snowpack measurement and modeling — including airborne laser altimetry, imaging spectroscopy, and integrated physics-based snowpack and hydrologic modeling — and on real-time integration with water supply forecasts, including for interstate water management. Names the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) and the Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS) among the other Federal agencies referenced in the program's snowpack-data provisions. Removes a prior interim report requirement.

gaps: It emphasizes new measurement technologies but does not require the resulting data to be made publicly available.
